text:
Olivia (People Ops): Heads-up — planning a small "Wall of Wins" microgrant + pocket-spot awards pop-up for next Tuesday (4/12). Goal: quick, public recognition moments and 20 $50 microgrants. Want to coordinate logistics here. :sparkles:
Maya (People Ops): love this. what time window were you thinking? lunchtime? :salute:
Olivia (People Ops): thinking 12:00-2:00 so teams can swing by during lunch. need volunteers for envelope prep, cashier, and a table lead for each side of the office.
Dan (People Ops): I can handle envelope printing and labels. any messaging copy we should use?
Olivia (People Ops): yes — short nomination blurb + 1-sentence why. We'll take nominations until Friday EOD. planner form: https://forms.gle/WallOfWinsForm (please don't share externally)
Lina (Eng): I can do a table lead at 12:00-1:00. can we get sticker packs for winners?
Sam (Design): I’ll do a small sticker sheet and two poster prints. sending proofs tonight.
Maya (People Ops): volunteers: @Lina (12-1), @Sam (table art), @Dan (envelopes). Need one more for cashier (card swipe) and one floater. @Finance-bot is that allowed for spot grants on the same-week payroll vs separate stipend?
Finance-bot: Quick note: for $50 microgrants to <20 people, we can run them as taxable awards processed outside regular payroll if we use the vendor cards. If you want them on payroll, cutoff is Fri 5pm PT for next-week payroll. Let us know preference.
Olivia (People Ops): prefer vendor cards to avoid payroll overhead. Dan — can you pick up prepaid cards and bring them on Monday evening? budget approved up to $1,100 incl. extras.
Dan (People Ops): Yep, will pick up 25 $50 cards and a few $20 'runner-up' cards.
Olivia (People Ops): Ok. Logistics checklist so far:
- Nomination form open through Fri EOD (Maya)
- Print envelopes + labels (Dan)
- Stickers + posters (Sam)
- Table leads: Lina (12-1), volunteer needed (1-2)
- Cashier: volunteer needed (12-2)
- Vendor cards purchased Mon eve (Dan)
- Compliance note + receipts to Finance (Olivia)
Maya (People Ops): I'll add a calendar invite and a short Slack announcement template. Proposed Slack announcement:

Hey all! Tomorrow: "Wall of Wins" pop-up in HQ kitchen 12-2. Nominate a teammate for a quick microgrant ($50) and a sticker. Form closes Friday. Swing by to celebrate wins! :confetti_ball:

Lina (Eng): suggestion — put a small table with examples of recent wins so people get ideas. I can print 3 quick one-liners.
Sam (Design): will prepare a 8.5x11 'What counts as a win' sheet.
Olivia (People Ops): volunteers still needed: cashier and 1:00-2:00 table lead. please DM me if you can help. also need 2 people to help stuff envelopes on Monday 5-6pm.
Kudos-bot: New nomination received from @lina: "Great troubleshooting on the inference pipeline — saved the Friday deploy"
Maya (People Ops): perfect example. also: reminder on privacy — don’t post private feedback in the poster; keep it celebratory.
Finance-bot: label receipts as "Wall of Wins microgrants" when uploading to the expense tracker.
Olivia (People Ops): Thanks everyone. I'll post the invite and a sign-up sheet for shifts in about 30m. :heart:
Lina (Eng): thanks! excited to see the stickers :grin:
Dan (People Ops): will confirm card pickup Monday noon, will also bring tape and envelopes.
Maya (People Ops): closing checklist before event: staff confirmed, cards + receipts secured, signage printed, slack promo scheduled. We’re at 70% — will update by Monday. :rocket:
